slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
方浩睁开眼的时候，天是灰的，地是裂的，连风都带着一股子陈年霉味，像是谁把三百年的老厨房掀了个底朝天。
他躺在一堆碎石瓦砾里，身上盖着半块写着“玄天宗”
三个字的破匾额，最后一个“宗”
字还缺了右下角，看起来像是被雷劈过八百回。
“我这是……穿越了？”
他喃喃自语，声音干得像砂纸磨锅底。
记忆最后的画面，还是他熬夜刷小说，一边啃着泡面一边吐槽：“主角开局签到就送神功，这系统怕不是批发的？”
结果下一秒，一道闪电精准劈中他家阳台的路由器，再睁眼，人就躺在这儿了。
“不是吧，真让我赶上了？”
他挣扎着坐起，环顾四周——断壁残垣，荒草过膝，几根歪斜的石柱上爬着不知名的藤蔓，空气中稀薄得几乎感知不到灵气，活脱脱一副“此地不宜久留”
的修仙界贫民窟模样。
正当他怀疑自己是不是穿到了哪个被灭门十八次的炮灰宗门遗址时，脑海中忽然响起一道机械音：
【叮！
万界签到系统已激活，宿主可每日签到一次，获取诸天万界气运馈赠。
【今日尚未签到，请选择是否立即执行？】
方浩愣了三秒，然后咧嘴笑了：“系统出品，绝不坑爹……这台词我熟！”
他清了清嗓子，心里默念：“签到。”
【签到成功！
获得《造化炼体诀》残篇（第一重），神秘青铜鼎一尊，奖励已自动存入随身空间。
话音刚落，他掌心一沉，一本泛黄古卷和一口巴掌大的青铜小鼎凭空出现。

那鼎通体布满古老符文，表面锈迹斑斑，却隐隐透出一丝温润光泽，像是被岁月打磨过的青铜镜子。
鼎身刻着一行小字：“签到万界，塔镇诸天。”
“好家伙，这鼎……不会就是签到塔本体吧？”
方浩眼睛一亮，赶紧把东西塞进怀里，又顺手把那块破匾往头上一扣，伪装成流浪散修。
他可不傻。
刚来就拿到好东西，万一有隐藏大佬蹲草丛里当钓鱼执法，他岂不是当场变烤鱼？
正想着，忽然“咔嚓”
一声，脚下一滑，踩碎了块青石板。
缝隙里，竟露出半枚暗红色的符文石，像是某种阵法残迹。
他蹲下身，手指刚触到石头，脑海中竟又响起一声轻震：
content_en:
When Fang Hao opened his eyes, the sky was gray, the ground was cracked, and even the wind carried an old musty smell, as if someone had turned a three-hundred-year-old kitchen upside down.
He was lying in a pile of rubble, with half of his body covered with "Xuan Tian Sect" written on it.
The broken plaque with three characters, the last "Zong"
The lower right corner of the word was missing, and it looked like it had been struck by lightning eight hundred times.
"Am I... traveling through time?"
He muttered to himself, his voice as dry as sandpaper grinding the bottom of a pot.
The last scene in my memory is of him staying up late reading a novel, chewing instant noodles and complaining: "The protagonist will be given magical powers when he signs in at the beginning. Is this system not wholesale?"
As a result, the next second, a bolt of lightning accurately struck the router on his balcony. When he opened his eyes again, he was lying here.
"No, you really caught up with me?"
He struggled to sit up and looked around - broken walls, weeds as high as his knees, unknown vines climbing on a few crooked stone pillars, and the air was so thin that he could hardly feel the aura. It was like "This place is not suitable for staying for a long time."
It looks like a slum in the world of immortality.
Just when he was wondering if he had traveled to the ruins of a cannon fodder sect that had been exterminated eighteen times, a mechanical voice suddenly sounded in his mind:
[Ding!
The sign-in system of all realms has been activated. The host can sign in once a day to obtain the gift of luck from all realms.
[You haven’t signed in today, please choose whether to execute it immediately? 】
Fang Hao was stunned for three seconds, then grinned: "Produced by the system, I will never cheat... I know these lines well!"
He cleared his throat and said silently: "Sign in."
[Sign in successfully!
Obtained the fragment (first level) of "The Art of Creation and Refining the Body" and a mysterious bronze tripod. The reward has been automatically stored in the portable space.
As soon as he finished speaking, his palm sank, and a yellowed ancient scroll and a palm-sized bronze cauldron appeared out of thin air.
The whole body of the tripod was covered with ancient runes, and its surface was stained with rust, but it had a warm luster, like a bronze mirror polished by time.
A line of small words is engraved on the body of the tripod: "Sign in all realms, and the tower will rule the heavens."
"Good guy, this tripod...isn't it just the sign-in tower itself?"
Fang Hao's eyes lit up, he quickly stuffed the things into his arms, then clasped the broken plaque on his head, pretending to be a wandering cultivator.
He's not stupid.
I got good stuff when I first arrived. If there was a hidden boss squatting in the grass as a fishing enforcer, wouldn't he turn into a grilled fish on the spot?
Just as I was thinking about it, suddenly "click"
With a sound, his feet slipped and crushed a bluestone slab.
In the gap, half of a dark red rune stone was exposed, like the remains of some kind of formation.
He squatted down, and as soon as his fingers touched the stone, there was another slight shock in his mind:
